_note: Replaces the float32 M=150 study (previous file: results/superseded/eff_rank.json). That study ran in float32 and solved the normal equations at mu=1e-8 (cond ~1e8), so its coefficient-recovery errors were round-off (in float64 both are ~||beta_true||), and it measured rank on M=150 points instead of the K=10 support set. This file: float64, stable lstsq ridge, K=10, many independent draws, identifiability in function space.

_schema.rows: flat per-sigma summary, MEANS over draws at K=10: eff_rank_H_* = value block H, eff_rank_stacked_* = [H; sqrt(w) G] with w=10.9; recover_err_* = ||beta_hat-beta_true|| and rmse_{val,der}_* = held-out RMSE of f / f', all at mu=1e-5; '_sobolev' = stacked w=10.9
_schema.detail: per sigma, per fit in {valonly, stacked_w<w>}: {mean,std,median} over draws of eff_rank_<fit>_<tol>, df_<fit>_mu<mu> (ridge degrees of freedom sum s^2/(s^2+mu)), log10_cond_restricted_<fit> (log10 s_1/s_r, r = #rows), log10_cond_topK_<fit> (log10 s_1/s_K, stacked only), rmse_{val,der}_<fit>_mu<mu>, relrmse_{val,der}_<fit>_mu<mu> (RMSE / RMS of the true f or f' on the held-out points), beta_err_<fit>_mu<mu>; median_sv_rel_<fit> = per-index median of log10(s_i/s_1)
_schema.continuity_M150: old recipe (seed 0, M=150 rank points, M_id=30 recovery points, stacked unweighted [H; G]) recomputed with the original float32 draws: ranks in float64 and float32, recovery in float64 via lstsq at mu=1e-8
_schema.solver_check: max over all fits/draws of ||b_normal_eq - b_lstsq|| / ||b_lstsq|| per mu

config.solver_check: float64 normal equations (torch.linalg.solve), asserted rel diff < 1e-6 at mu >= 1e-5
config.points: torch.Generator seed 20000+d: K support, n_test held-out, then beta_true
